setup_fastcsp_logger: setup a centralized FastCSP logger with configurable file and console output handlers
print_fastcsp_header: print the FastCSP banner header with optional restart info and stage list
log_config_pretty: log a configuration dictionary as pretty-printed JSON to the FastCSP logger
get_fastcsp_logger: get or create a FastCSP logger from a config dict and root directory
log_error: log an exception with its type and full traceback to the FastCSP logger
